The '''Noslo-19 slug rifle''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] that was manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]. [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar]], a [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]-based [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], used a Noslo-19 with specialty ammunition.

==Description==
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] Noslo-19 slug rifle was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]<ref name="db" /> with a large [[Stock/Legends|stock]] and trigger that could be operated by a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid's]] [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. The [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] included a long [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and a small [[targeting scope]]. The Noslo-19 also had a removable shoulder strap attached to the stock and the barrel in front of the scope. [[Color/Legends|Colored]] silver,<ref name="rs">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=#07: Bane Malar|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC07Bane.asp}}</ref> the Noslo-19's stock, pistol grip, and handguard were brown in color.<ref name="db" />

==History==
[[File:Malar_tk.jpg|thumb|left|241px|Bane Malar (left) armed with his Noslo-19.]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]-affiliated [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar]] favored a powerful Noslo-19 with specialty ammunition. With Malar operating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], he used the customized slug rifle along with an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]], the latter to adopt to Kessel's thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="db" /> At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Malar was armed with the Noslo-19 when he fought a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], whom he disarmed using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="swgtcg">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Bane Malar}}</ref>

At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="date note">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Bane Malar}} shows [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar]] using the Noslo-19 when he was at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. With that card stating Malar was plotting to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Jabba at the [[Time/Legends|time]], {{DB|character|banemalar|Malar, Bane}} specified that Malar was in the palace before [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the latter's arrival to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Malar was on<ref name="db" /> the planet<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]],<ref name="db" /> a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the planet.<ref name="rotj" /> Malar had accepted a contract from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Jabba,<ref name="db" /> and took the Noslo-19 with him while he was at the palace.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Bane Malar}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Noslo-19 slug rifle was first depicted by an illustration in the [[1992]] ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'',<ref name="httes">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> before being also pictured by Bane Malar's card in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] was first named<ref name="db" /> when [[Edward M. Erdelac]], writing as "caledre,"<ref name="Part 1">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}} establishes that [[Edward M. Erdelac]] wrote the backstory for [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar]], and {{DB|character|banemalar|Malar, Bane}} further states that "caledre" was the author's screen name.</ref> wrote about Bane Malar for [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="db" /> with the entry published on [[March 27]], [[2008]].<ref name="Retrospective">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20080321.html|text=What's the Story: The Fans Set the Facts|date=2008-03-27}}</ref> In [[July]] the same year,<ref name="Toywiz">{{WebCite|url=https://toywiz.com/star-wars-return-of-the-jedi-legacy-collection-2008-droid-factory-bane-malar-action-figure-bd07|text=Star Wars Return of the Jedi 2008 Legacy Collection Droid Factory Bane Malar 3.75 Action Figure BD07 Hasbro Toys - ToyWiz|work=[https://www.toywiz.com ToyWiz]|archivedate=20221106201808}}</ref> the Noslo-19 slug rifle was also included in a Bane Malar action figure released as part of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' line. The rifle was colored silver for the action figure,<ref name="rs" /> contradicting the black coloration of the rifle used by the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game.<ref name="CCG" /> This article treats the silver color as the rifle's [[in-universe]] color.
